newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker Maritime wins NOK 560 mln oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Aker Maritime wins NOK 560 mln oil deal.

text.p: Norwegian offshore company Aker Maritime ASA said on Wednesday it had received a contract to fit out a production ship for the Banff oilfield in the British sector of the North Sera.
The contract was awarded by Norway's Petroleum Geo-Services ASA, Aker Maritime said in a statement to the Oslo bourse.
"The award is a breakthrough for Aker Maritime as a total supplier to the British offshore market," the company said.
The value of the contract is 400 million crowns.
Aker said PGS had awarded Aker's Maritime Tentech division a separate contract for planning and procurement for the Banff vessel woth 160 million crowns.
